text:
DeployBot: publish attempt repo=redwood/worker image=worker:20260321-zz9 -> PROVENANCE_WARN: layered checksum mismatch for linux/arm64; publish quarantined.
noah: saw the alert. Are pulls failing or just provenance guard?
tara: just guard. runtime reports manifest list present but attestation shows layer sha mismatch compared to registry. suspect CI artifact corruption during push.
infra-bot: runner build-45 had an interrupted upload at 10:03Z, retry succeeded but with different chunk ordering; storage reports identical blob sizes but checksums differ.
release-mgr: change window 30m. options: 1) re-push the exact artifact from build cache (fast) 2) retag previous attested digest and hold arm64 3) full rollback. Preference: re-push if we can ensure checksum parity.
noah: I can fetch artifact from cache and verify local checksum before pushing. will run `s3 cp` then `sha256sum` then `gcloud auth configure-docker` + push.
ops: beware: previous push may have left orphaned attestation record. If we re-push, ensure we re-generate attestation referencing new manifest digest.
tara: commands I'll run on control node:
```
# fetch artifact
aws s3 cp s3://ci-artifacts/worker/20260321/worker-arm64.tar.gz ./worker-arm64.tar.gz
sha256sum worker-arm64.tar.gz
# push image and sign
./load_and_push.sh --tar worker-arm64.tar.gz --tag worker:20260321-zz9 --platform linux/arm64
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/attest-key gcr.io/redwood/worker:20260321-zz9
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/attest-key gcr.io/redwood/worker:20260321-zz9
```
infra-bot: note: pushing from control node will avoid intermittent runner network; KMS quota OK.
noah: doing checksum compare now. local sha matches CI build metadata: OK. starting push.
DeployBot: reminder: after republish, run `deploybot reconcile-manifest worker:20260321-zz9` to refresh promotion locks.
noah: push complete. cosign sign succeeded and verify shows OK. registry shows attestation and matching layer checksum.
ops: removing orphan attestation blob created earlier to avoid confusion (cleanup ticket INF-2026-58).
release-mgr: promoting canary for arm64; monitoring 5m for errors. update release notes: "arm64 republish to fix provenance checksum mismatch; no code changes."
tara: filing postmortem item: add pre-push checksum verification in pipeline and improve chunked upload ordering checks.
infra-bot: scheduled job created to run `s3 md5` vs `local sha256` mapping check and alert on mismatch (ticket INF-2026-59).
release-mgr: closing thread if no anomalies after 10m. thanks team.
